messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight check: chart=cache-v2.1 detected serviceAccount drift for deployment=cache-worker. expected=cache-runner-sa actual=cache-runner-sa-v2 in 4/10 canary pods. severity=warn. command: `kubectl -n prod get deploy cache-worker -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName}'`
jenny: that would explain the RBAC denies in canary logs. Did overlay rename the SA or did chart bump it?
marco: promoted chart version is 2.1.0 (no SA change). overlay team-cache/canary-values.yaml contains `serviceAccount.name: cache-runner-sa-v2`. Merge slipped in.
lina: options: abort promotion, pin SA to expected name during promote, or keep canary isolated. Given change window open for 2h, I'd vote pin + retain canary for investigation.
jenny: plan: helm upgrade cache-release charts/cache --namespace prod --version 2.1.0 --reuse-values --set serviceAccount.name=cache-runner-sa --set imagePromotion.note=pin-sa-2026-06-10 and keep canary labeled `tier=canary`. Also create RBAC watch.
marco: commands:
```bash
helm upgrade cache-release charts/cache --namespace prod --version 2.1.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set serviceAccount.name=cache-runner-sa \
  --set imagePromotion.note=pin-sa-2026-06-10
kubectl -n prod label deployment cache-worker tier=canary --overwrite
```
release-manager: document the manual pin in release notes and audit. ping infra-oncall to watch for RBAC errors for 30m.
lina: rollback surface: `helm rollback cache-release 4` and unpin. If canary misbehaves, scale canary down: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy cache-worker --replicas=0 -l tier=canary`.
marco: helm dry-run shows the only divergence is serviceAccount.name in overlay. helm template diff snippet:
```diff
--- a/templates/deployment.yaml
+++ b/templates/deployment.yaml
@@
-      serviceAccountName: cache-runner-sa-v2
+      serviceAccountName: cache-runner-sa  # pinned for rollout
```
infra-oncall-bot: watch scheduled: cache-rbac-watch (30m). thresholds: rbact_denies>1, pod_restart>2.
jenny: creating ticket RD-6219 to reconcile overlays and SA naming. release-notes: "Pinned serviceAccount to cache-runner-sa for rollout; canary instances running cache-runner-sa-v2 retained for investigation. Follow-up: align overlays and RBAC."
marco: executing promote now after verified dry-run. will post completion ts.
marco: promote completed at 3999991275. Helm upgrade success, rollout complete. Canaries (4 pods) left labeled tier=canary and still using cache-runner-sa-v2 for postmortem.
lina: monitoring OK so far, no new RBAC denies. keeping 30m watch.
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned rollout. action items: RD-6219 assigned to @marco and @jenny. Close thread after watch if stable. :white_check_mark:
